subject: Console & API enablement — coordinate session for Velovent
messages:
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: Amanda Chen <amanda.chen@velovent.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 18 Apr 2027 15:22:00 -0400
Subject: Console & API enablement — coordinate session for Velovent

Hi Amanda —

Thanks again for the call last week. We'd like to get a focused 60‑minute enablement session on the Redwood Console + API flows so your integrations team can do a quick live test against the sandbox. Proposed goals:
- Quick intro (10m) — account & permissions mapping
- Console walkthrough (15m) — model catalog, routing, and rollouts
- API demo (20m) — calls, streaming, auth, and sample response handling
- Q&A + next steps (15m)

Proposed 60‑minute windows (all ET):
- Wed Apr 21, 10:00–11:00 ET
- Wed Apr 21, 15:00–16:00 ET
- Thu Apr 22, 09:00–10:00 ET

If none of those work, please suggest two 60‑minute blocks that do. If you have an API engineer you want on the call, please CC them and we’ll make sure a Redwood engineer (Dev) is on.

Attached: prework checklist and a draft agenda for the session. Also sharing a HubSpot link for the deal so we have the correct attendees.

Thanks — look forward to locking this in.

Best,
Logan Wright
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
logan.wright@redwood.com
(415) 555-0182

Attachments: Velovent_prework-checklist.pdf, Redwood_console-api-agenda.pdf

Hi Logan —

Thanks — those windows are helpful. We have a leadership sync that runs over the morning on Wed, so the Apr 21 times won't work for our team. Thu Apr 22 looks much better. Would 11:00–12:00 ET on Thu work for you?

Please include our API lead (Icc: integrations@velovent.com) and our SSO admin — I’ll loop them in if the time is confirmed. We also have a short network maintenance scheduled for Thu morning; I’ll attach a quick inventory of the ACLs and IP allowlist we plan to check before the call.
